archetype: Archetype 5 (Luxury) mixed with Archetype 3 (Pastel & Soft) structural playfulness

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID (Dense, functional, gap-6)

components_strategy.buttons: Rounded-full for the primary Clock In/Out CTA to add structural playfulness. Solid gold (#FACC15) with black text. Use subtle scale on hover. Add data-testid to all.
components_strategy.cards: Solid background (#121214) with a subtle 1px border (border-yellow-400/20). Rounded-2xl for a friendly feel despite the dark luxury theme.
components_strategy.inputs: Shadcn UI customized: bg-zinc-900 border-zinc-800 focus:border-yellow-400 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-yellow-400/50 rounded-xl.
components_strategy.tables: Go cardless for lists if possible. Left aligned. Row hover bg-zinc-800/50.
components_strategy.navigation: Collapsible left sidebar for Admin. Topbar for Worker. Use Glassmorphism backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 for sticky elements.
components_strategy.toast: Use Sonner for toast notifications, dark theme with gold icons.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: Buttons must have explicit hover text colors and bg colors. Cards elevate slightly -translate-y-1 shadow-lg shadow-yellow-400/5.
interactions_and_motion.clock_in_button: Pulsing animation: animate-pulse on the drop-shadow or ring to encourage interaction. Make it massive and prominent in the UI.

image_urls.description: Gold letter on a black background, to be used as the main company logo in the header/sidebar.
Professional worker avatar photo for the user profile dropdown/Admin view.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all fonts are loaded properly via Google Fonts (Outfit and Manrope) in index.html.
Ensure you write .js (React with JavaScript) instead of TypeScript (.tsx) for the frontend.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Apply Outfit instead.
Build a robust layout for Admin with a sidebar, and a simpler topbar layout for the Worker dashboard.
Implement JWT auth (email/password) handling for Admin and Worker.
Admin Dashboard: View all workers, form to create worker accounts, assign tasks with title/description/fixed price, view payroll dashboard with per-worker total earnings.
Worker Dashboard: MUST feature a massive 'Clock In / Clock Out' primary action with active shift timer and today's hours.
Worker Dashboard: Display task list (assigned/in-progress/completed) with price visible. Allow marking tasks as complete to log earnings.
Include a 'Time entries history' per worker section.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for the header/sidebar.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, task items).
